title: ICE’s mid-2026 interior enforcement surge lifts arrests and detention, but removals remain hard to audit
summary: ICE reported record-level bookings and a July arrest pace averaging 1,593 a day, while detainees include a large share without criminal convictions and ICE says its data is released with delays that complicate verifying downstream removal outcomes.
